name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`. It meets WCAG 2.2 AA for keyboard users without relying on color alone, and the thicker ring improves touch target visibility on mobile. The trade-off is slightly larger visual weight, but that’s acceptable since focus indicators must be noticeable.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG 2.2 requires 3px at 4.5:1 for that combo. Better alternative: use 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and `forced-colors: active`. Settle it by testing with a screen reader user who toggles both modes.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and `forced-colors: active`. It meets WCAG 2.2 AA for all users, including those toggling both reduced motion and high contrast modes. The trade-off is a thinner ring, but it’s necessary to avoid excluding users who rely on system-level contrast overrides. Testing with a screen reader user will confirm the choice works in real-world use.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 3px at 4.5:1 still fails users who *only* toggle high contrast mode—WCAG 2.2 requires 3px at 4.5:1 *or* 1px at 7:1 for high contrast alone. Better alternative: use 4px at 7:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and test forced-colors separately. Settle it by testing with a screen reader user who toggles high contrast mode *without* reduced motion.
